rationale: spec-driven-development 1.0.1 replaces the fallback YAML parser in scripts/spec_flow.py with a strict one (quoted scalars, refused flow syntax, duplicate keys, bad indentation and control characters) and adds two tests. The bundled internal/spec/scripts/spec_flow.py already carries this parser: its scalar and parse_simple_yaml functions are byte-identical to e9c04b6, and tests/spec covers the same refusals, so no engine change is needed. Local 1.4.0 change in the actual-diff integration: snapshots.py records gitlinks (path and commit) without copying content instead of refusing any tree with a submodule (other unusual modes are still refused), and run_engine.capture_verification refuses a staged or captured gitlink change with submodule_changed, before any snapshot or spec-engine state change, because the actual-diff review cannot inspect submodule content. README.md and PROVENANCE.md updated.

tests: The bundled fallback-parser regressions (tests.spec FallbackYamlRegressionTests and test_spec_flow ConfigTests) pass unchanged. Regression tests written first and seen failing before their fixes on October 2, 2026: tests.test_snapshots test_gitlink_is_recorded_without_content, test_changed_gitlink_between_snapshots_is_reported, test_staged_gitlink_change_is_found_before_capture; tests.test_rich_integration test_unchanged_submodule_does_not_block_capture_verification (red: UNSUPPORTED_TREE) and test_changed_gitlink_refuses_capture_verification_with_a_clear_code (red: DIRECTORY_SCOPE instead of submodule_changed); tests.test_run_engine GateTimeoutTests (six tests; red: planned timeouts ignored and accepted unvalidated, no timeout_seconds) and tests.test_workflows test_the_gate_step_passes_each_planned_gate_timeout (red: no --timeout passed). All pass after the fixes. Full suite on October 2, 2026 before this record, on the final code (one later docstring-only edit in snapshots.py): tools tests 20/20 and the plug-in catalog 529/529 in eight shards, 0 skipped, 0 failures. make check after this record.
